source: The memory hierarchy also creates resource trade-offs. Larger tiles can increase reuse but consume more shared memory and registers. Deeper software pipelines can overlap transfers with compute but require additional buffering. A design that maximizes reuse can still lose if it leaves too little occupancy or creates bank conflicts.
zh: 内存层次结构还造成资源权衡。较大的块可以增加重用，但会消耗更多的共享内存和寄存器。更深层次的软件管道可以与计算重叠传输，但需要额外的缓冲。如果占用率太低或造成银行冲突，最大化再利用的设计仍然会失败。
